tools.name: check_domain_price
tools.description: Check live local pricing and availability for one or more domains using partner-specific ESB rules without writing cache rows.

tools.name: suggest_available_domains
tools.description: Generate AI-backed domain ideas from a business brief and pre-check availability locally across partner-appropriate TLDs.

tools.name: generate_checkout_link
tools.description: Create a checkout URL for available domains using a raw JWT token. For special TLDs, do not collect field values in chat; tell the customer what checkout will require.

tools.name: get_domain_requirements
tools.description: Return MCP-only restricted TLD eligibility requirements and checkout flow choices so the customer can be told what information checkout will require.

tools.name: list_my_domains
tools.description: List domains for the authenticated Encirca account from live RegyREST domain data plus read-only ESB task fallback.

tools.name: get_domain_details
tools.description: Return sanitized read-only details for a domain owned by the authenticated Encirca account. Auth codes and contact records are never returned.

tools.name: list_expiring_domains
tools.description: List domains from the authenticated Encirca account that expire within a configurable number of days.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: List read-only ESB domain invoices/orders for the authenticated Encirca account.

tools.name: get_account_profile
tools.description: Return the authenticated Encirca account profile and selected team profile from the verified Auth0 token.

tools.name: get_account_identity
tools.description: Return the currently authenticated Auth0 user and selected Encirca team identity. Requires Authorization: Bearer <Auth0 access token>.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_account_identity" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Return the currently authenticated Auth0 user and selected Encirca team identity. Requires Authorization: Bearer <Auth0 access token>.
